##### Project general facts

Wallaya Residence Nai Harn is a stylish low-rise condominium development inspired by the art of slow living. Under the concept of “Slow Living, Refined”, this project reimagines modern luxury through harmony, mindfulness, and intention. Comprising three elegantly designed buildings, the residence offers a collection of studios and spacious one to three-bedroom apartments, each crafted to foster calm, clarity, and a deeper connection with oneself and nature.

Residents enjoy an exceptional range of facilities designed for relaxation and well-being. The complex features a spacious main swimming pool with sun loungers, a separate children’s pool, lush landscaped gardens, a fully equipped fitness center, co-working spaces, a rooftop cinema, spa and wellness facilities, a kids’ club, and a restaurant with a terrace. Round-the-clock security with CCTV surveillance ensures complete peace of mind.

Every residence at Wallaya Residence Nai Harn is designed with modern comfort and functionality in mind. Expansive windows flood the interiors with natural light, while open-plan layouts create bright, airy living spaces. Kitchens are fully appointed, and bedrooms offer serene retreats. The thoughtful integration of indoor and outdoor spaces allows residents to enjoy panoramic views of the sea and mountains, creating a home where every detail nurtures the soul.

##### Parking
Shared and private parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the peaceful and sought-after Nai Harn area of southern Phuket, this exceptional location places residents just a short drive from one of the island’s most stunning beaches. Nai Harn Beach is renowned for its golden sands, crystal-clear waters, and relaxed atmosphere, attracting discerning travelers seeking tranquility and natural beauty.

The location is distinguished by its exceptional convenience and serene surroundings. Local shops, charming cafes, world-class restaurants, and family-friendly recreational areas are all within easy reach. Nearby attractions include scenic viewpoints, cultural landmarks, and pristine beaches such as Rawai, Yanui, and Kata.

For those seeking a residence that embodies coastal elegance, mindful living, and strong investment potential, Nai Harn delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of natural beauty, five-star amenities, and a peaceful, sophisticated address makes it one of Phuket’s most desirable locations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of island living — serene, refine and effortlessly connected.
